Ares Management Corp. raised $4.2 billion — more than quadruple its initial target — for a debut secondaries fund that will provide capital to private managers.

The Ares Global Structured Solutions Fund will mostly provide preferred equity to managers looking to make larger commitments to their latest funds, seed new strategies and arrange for succession planning, according to Nate Walton , the firm’s head of secondaries.
